study_design: Cross-sectional case-control biomarker comparison of newly diagnosed prostate cancer patients, BPH patients, and healthy controls.
reason: The study compares serum trace-element levels in newly diagnosed prostate cancer patients with control groups. It does not analyze high-grade, advanced, metastatic, lethal, or otherwise aggressive prostate cancer incidence.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Serum Se, Zn, and Mn levels of prostate cancer patients were significantly decreased compared to control groups.
estimate_classifications.reason: The zinc comparison concerns general prostate cancer case status, not aggressive disease.
